record.paper_title: Open Problems in Constructive Function Theory
record.original_question: Find an explicit integral formula for the generalized translation operator associated with the Jacobi-type weight on the simplex, analogous to the known integral formula in the classical ball case and compatible with the intertwining operator for the corresponding Dunkl operators.

evidence.quote: The open question calls for an integral formula for the generalized translation operator with respect to the weight function W_κ on the simplex.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $T^d=\{x=(x_1,\dots,x_d)\in\mathbb{R}^d: x_i\ge 0,\ x_1+\cdots+x_d\le 1\}$ be the standard simplex in $\mathbb{R}^d$, and set $x_{d+1}:=1-x_1-\cdots-x_d$. For a multi-index $\kappa=(\kappa_1,\dots,\kappa_{d+1})$ with $\kappa_i\ge 0$, consider the Jacobi-type weight on the simplex
$$W_\kappa^T(x)=\prod_{i=1}^{d+1} x_i^{\kappa_i-1/2},\qquad x\in T^d.$$
Let $\{P_n\}$ be the orthogonal polynomial expansion in $L^2(T^d, W_\kappa^T)$. There is an associated generalized translation operator $\tau_y^T$ defined spectrally by
$$\tau_y^T f(x)=\sum_{n\ge 0}\frac{P_n(x,y;W_\kappa^T)\;\hat f_n}{\|P_n\|^2},$$
where $P_n(x,y;W_\kappa^T)$ are the reproducing kernels of the orthogonal polynomial subspaces. In the analogous case of the unit ball $B^d$ with weight $W_\kappa^B(x)=\prod_{i=1}^{d}|x_i|^{2\kappa_i}(1-\|x\|^2)^{\kappa_{d+1}-1/2}$, the corresponding translation operator is known to admit an explicit integral representation that is compatible with the Dunkl intertwining operator $V_\kappa$.

Problem: Find an explicit integral representation for $\tau_y^T f(x)$ on $T^d$ that is positive (or otherwise bounded on appropriate function spaces), is compatible with the intertwining operator for the Dunkl operators associated to $W_\kappa^T$, and reduces, under the standard quadratic map $B^d\to T^d$, to the known integral formula for the generalized translation operator on the ball.
artifact.category_tag: Dunkl operators and orthogonal polynomials on the simplex
artifact.status_search_result: Searches turned up extensive work on generalized translation operators associated with Dunkl-type weights on the ball, sphere, and real line, and on convolution/approximation theory on the simplex via the quadratic map from the ball. However, no source providing an explicit integral formula for the generalized translation operator with respect to the Jacobi-type weight $W_\kappa^T$ directly on the simplex (compatible with the Dunkl intertwining operator) was found. The current status appears unresolved based on available search evidence.

status_evidence.title: Generalized translation operator and approximation in several variables
status_evidence.snippet: Generalized translation operators for weight functions defined on the unit ball and on the standard simplex are studied and used to study weighted approximation and orthogonal expansions in several variables.
status_evidence.claim: Translation operators on ball and simplex are studied via spectral expansions, but explicit integral formulas are highlighted on the ball.

status_evidence.title: Convolution operator and maximal function for Dunkl transform
status_evidence.snippet: For a family of weight functions invariant under a finite reflection group, analysis related to the Dunkl transform is carried out using the generalized translation operator.
status_evidence.claim: Integral/convolution formulas are developed for ball/sphere Dunkl settings, with the simplex case typically derived only via the ball-to-simplex quadratic map.
